faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences Nagpur (AIIMS Nagpur) for filling up project-based healthcare vacancies in Maharashtra under an ICMR funded project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post announced in AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Nagpur has announced vacancies for the Project Nurse-III position under the Department of Physiology for an ICMR-funded research project.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Project Nurse-III position in this recruitment notification released by AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Project Nurse-III?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. Nursing degree or a B.Sc. Nursing degree with 2 years of relevant professional experience to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to AIIMS Nagpur Project Nurse-III?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 35 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this criteria before submitting their applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for this role?
faq.answer: Selected candidates appointed as Project Nurse-III will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs.33,600/- per month as per the project guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the complete application by soft copy and through the online google form is 15-10-2026.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to submit their complete applications through the provided online google form and send a hard copy to the designated address at AIIMS Nagpur.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for AIIMS Nagpur Project Nurse-III?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting candidates based on desirable criteria, followed by a written or skill test, and a personal interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification released by AIIMS Nagpur for the Project Nurse-III position.
